en: Vintage multi-view postcard with four black-and-white photographs of large institutional buildings and streets. Each image is captioned in German, all referring to the "Landeskrankenhaus" (state hospital). The views show a convalescent home, the main avenue lined with trees and multi‑storey hospital wings, another broader view titled simply "Landeskrankenhaus", and a domed chapel building. At the bottom center the city name "GRAZ" is printed.
